title: Warfare SMP
description: exciting / modern / strategic modpack for Forge 1.20.1
body:
![the title of the modpack](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fc9b2f43f266f98dbe934c9ad35f9032008accf9_0.webp)

a strategic and war Mod pack where a balance between brute force and intelligence is key


- **The world has been plunged to war.**
- **You and your team mates,**
- **travel across the wild terrain.**
- **to take back what was lost.**


## Features:
- 🏭**Factories**-Build large **automatic** factories which produce **key reasources** faster and easyier
- 🤝**Skill Balancing**-can play to anyones **strengths** or **weaknesses** with many different aspects of skill needed 
- 🏚️**apocalyptic structures**-structures can be found which hold **loot** or mysterys of the past
- 🔫**mass artillery**-**Big Cannons** or machine turrets are big help for protection
- ⚡**electricity**-has **unlimited** potenial with easy transportation of power
- 🚂**Trains**-can be used to **drill**, **transport**, **travel** and so much more
- 🪷**quality of life**-find info of blocks, entities, your surrounding area with **high accuracy**
- ⚙️**easy to balance**-many mods to **balance** the playing field whether people try x-raying or useing minimap for an advantage
- 💥**immersive suppressing**-a few mods adds a **realistic effect** when explosions go off near you or if bullets whizz past you


- **why Warfare SMP is different to other war/create modpacks:**
- this has many gun and create mods to help aid many different skill sets and when combined can be a fun experience for many players


# - **Q and A**
## - is there a wiki?
  yes,there is a wiki in the links page of the modpack
  
## - is this multiplayer?
  yes, this is multiplayer, infact we encourage you to play with friends for a more impactful play
  
## - where can i get a server to play on?
  you can get a server from many places: websites, realms, or a physical server, which we recommend. however if you cant get a physical server yourself consider joining the discord and join our pre-built server


# - known bugs:

### - breaking rails with effortless structures 
- if you have placed down curved rails and decide to break them with the mod effortless structures, your game will crash
